facts.text: The US Grant opened on October 15, 1910, after five years of construction in the heart of downtown San Diego.
facts.excerpt: The US Grant opened its doors with great pomp and circumstance on October 15, 1910. After five years of construction in the heart of downtown San Diego

facts.text: The hotel is recognized as a Gaslamp Quarter historic hotel and preserves its architectural legacy.
facts.excerpt: Recognized as a Gaslamp Quarter historic hotel, The US Grant preserves its rich architectural legacy while delivering thoughtful service and modern amenities.

facts.text: The hotel holds a collection of artworks, including sculptures, ironwork, murals and paintings, by European, American and Native American artists.
facts.excerpt: featuring a $6.5 million collection of distinctive artworks, including stunning sculptures, ironwork, murals and paintings. Created by carefully selected, world-renowned artists from European, American and Native American backgrounds

facts.text: The concierge team leads a complimentary tour of the hotel's history and culture for overnight guests, starting Saturdays at 11:00 AM from the Concierge desk.
facts.excerpt: This complimentary tour is available exclusively to our overnight hotel guests and begins every Saturday at 11:00 AM from the Concierge desk.

facts.text: Every evening at dusk, the concierge team lights candles in the grand lobby, continuing the historic 'keeper of candles' tradition.
facts.excerpt: Our concierge team continues this historic tradition at our legendary property in our grand lobby every evening at dusk to celebrate the lighting of the candles.

facts.text: Champagne Under The Chandeliers offers complimentary gourmet bites with live piano music on Saturdays from 4 to 6 pm; Champagne is available for purchase.
facts.excerpt: Savor the simple pleasures of Champagne and complimentary gourmet bites, accompanied by the elegant tones of live piano music. The perfect way to elevate your weekend. Available every Saturday from 4–6 pm. Champagne is available for purchase.

facts.text: Grant Grill serves AAA/CAA Four Diamond cuisine in an Art Deco setting, with seasonal dishes from California produce and Pacific seafood.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy AAA/CAA Four Diamond cuisine in an Art Deco setting, with seasonal dishes from California produce and Pacific seafood

facts.text: Grant Grill has operated since 1951, with mahogany wood, fleur de lis banquettes and white linen-topped tables.
facts.excerpt: From the sumptuous surroundings – including classic mahogany wood, fleur de lis banquettes, and white linen-topped tables – to the ever-evolving seasonal menus, Grant Grill carries a tradition of excellence since 1951.

facts.text: In 1969 a group of local female attorneys staged a sit-in that ended Grant Grill's men-only policy, and a brass plaque commemorating the 'Grant Grill Invasion' is displayed outside the entry.
facts.excerpt: Today, the “Grant Grill Invasion” as it has been called, is still applauded as a turning point in San Diego’s history, and a brass plaque commemorating their feat is on display outside Grant Grill’s entry.

facts.text: Grant Grill Lounge has Mooi crystal chandeliers, granite-topped tables, mosaics and metallic fixtures, and hosts live music.
facts.excerpt: enjoy an evening in our modern lounge with Mooi crystal chandeliers, sleek granite-topped tables, brilliant mosaics, and metallic fixtures.

facts.text: A Day in the Life of a Grant Grill Chef includes a behind-the-scenes kitchen tour, tastings, cooking a dish and a surprise wine or cocktail tasting.
facts.excerpt: includes a behind the scenes tour of the Grant Grill’s culinary operations, exclusive tastings from a scratch kitchen, opportunity for guests to participate in cooking and preparing a dish designed around the offering of the day

facts.text: Pillowtop beds feature 350-thread-count sheets and designer duvets.
facts.excerpt: Sumptuously outfitted, our luxury pillowtop beds feature 350-thread-count sheets and designer duvets

facts.text: Marble bathrooms in select suites feature deep soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms in select suites feature deep soaking tubs for calming retreats in San Diego

facts.text: Rooms showcase evocative art and finishes.
facts.excerpt: Showcasing evocative art and finishes, our hotel rooms in downtown San Diego offer refined elegance

facts.text: Suites include a Presidential Multi-Level Suite with a balcony and living room, and a top-floor Penthouse Suite.
facts.excerpt: Presidential Multi-Level Suite, 1 Bedroom, 1 King Bed, Balcony, Living Room

facts.text: The hotel is near Little Italy and the Gaslamp Quarter, at the heart of San Diego's dining, culture and nightlife.
facts.excerpt: Ideally situated near Little Italy and the Gaslamp Quarter, The US Grant, a Luxury Collection Hotel places guests at the heart of San Diego’s dynamic dining, culture, and nightlife.

facts.text: Nearby attractions include Balboa Park, the San Diego Zoo, Petco Park and the Gaslamp Quarter.
facts.excerpt: Guests can explore nearby attractions including Balboa Park, the San Diego Zoo, Petco Park, and the vibrant Gaslamp Quarter

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day and is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Open 7 days a week, 24 hours a day

facts.text: The hotel offers valet parking only, with off-site parking lots and garages in the area.
facts.excerpt:
Additional Parking Information**

Valet Parking only

facts.text: The hotel has 19 event venues totaling more than 33,000 square feet.
facts.excerpt: With 19 different venue options accumulating to more than 33,000 square feet

facts.text: The 11-story historic building has a lobby with chandeliers, glossy tile floors and Corinthian-style columns.
facts.excerpt: Inside, the lobby feels palatial, with sparkling chandeliers, glossy tile floors, and impressive Corinthian-style columns.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, one per room.
facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 35.0 lbs.

facts.text: The hotel says Grant Grill Lounge is renowned for some of the nation's best cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Renowned for shaking up some of the nation’s best cocktails

facts.text: Grant Grill Lounge has live music on Friday and Saturday nights.
facts.excerpt: Set in the Gaslamp District, it exudes timeless luxury, enhanced by live music Friday-Saturday.

facts.text: Grant Grill Lounge comes alive with live music Thursday through Saturday nights.
facts.excerpt: the Grant Grill Lounge comes alive Thursday thru Saturday nights when it transforms into one of San Diego’s favorite live music venues

facts.text: Many room windows face other rooms, so guests may want to close the blinds for privacy.
facts.excerpt: Just don't forget to close your blinds for privacy—many of the windows face other rooms.

facts.text: San Diego International Airport is about 3 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: SAN is located approximately 3.0 Miles from the hotel.

contradictions.note: p1 lounge section says live music Thursday thru Saturday; p3 and p1 restaurant card say Friday-Saturday
